lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p18 - Listen and draw.

details: Listen and draw reviews the key language from the unit and helps students practise listening for detail.
Look for careful listening, correct identification of which part of the face to draw, and the correct number of that part of the face drawn.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p18 - 3. Point and say.

details: Point and say reviews the colours, further reviews the target vocabulary from the unit, and helps students practise giving simple pictures descriptions and presenting their work.

Look for accurate identification of the parts of the face the monsters have got, correct identification of the colours used, accurate pronunciation of the target language, and confident participation.
